title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a package commit's plan and revert address the committing package's own row; a deleted row's restore asks the package-less close
body:

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ86dqPUQ7umCq81TqWVdRR92)_
Fixes #29414

domain:server#5 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZ5jYNfPGLvPV8LYRe

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none needed — `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` already says the package-less save, reset and rollback of a movable row are refused once movable (D11), and places every customization of an installed base in its paired `.custom`; nothing it says becomes false.

> **Freeze:** this PR touches `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, frozen under seat post #27737 (comment 6594835694) until the #25467 section-3 (data CRUD) PR merges. It does not land before the lift; after that split lands, main is merged here and the three `protocol.ts` hunks are re-placed (the seat runs a delta review then).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：包提交的撤销计划（`publish-drafts` 记录的 `existedBefore`/`prevVersion`）只读发布包自己的那一行；按提交撤销（`POST /packages/:id/commits/:commitId/revert`，整包回滚经它）的删除与恢复两支都只针对提交所属包自己的行。被撤销项的行已被删掉时，恢复会写无包行，现在先问"无包写入关闭"判据（与逐项回滚同一判据、同一句），五种覆盖类型被拒、不写任何东西。
- 为什么改：实测 main 上，基础包旧行旁边的 `.custom` 配对包首次发布，被记成"编辑了基础行的版本 10"；撤销这次提交时去找基础行，被 #29390 的关闭拒掉，配对包的覆盖仍在服务、撤销答 `success:false`。另一路：基础行删除后撤销其编辑提交，会插入一条无包行（#28576 关闭的那种写入）。
- 风险与回滚：只改提交门的寻址；已记录的旧提交保留其旧计划。删除行后撤销从"静默写无包行"变为逐项拒绝（收窄，故 `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`）。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 的 `revertCommit`（`commitPackageId` 与恢复支的两个关闭判据）、`publishPackageDrafts` 计划读、`sys-metadata-repository.ts` 的 `restoreVersion` 新增 `packageId`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts`，预期 25 个全过（其中 3 个 #29414 用例在 main 上为红）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（解冻后，且需一次 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 复核）。

## What changes

- **The plan names the publishing package's row.** `publishPackageDrafts` reads each item's pre-publish active row with `package_id: request.packageId`. Every draft it promotes is listed under that package and promoted into that package's row, so another package's row of the name is not the item's pre-publish state.
- **Both revert limbs name the committing package's row.** `revertCommit` reads `commitPackageId` off the commit row and states it on the soft-remove limb's read and delete, and on the restore limb's read and `restoreVersion`. A pair creation commit beside a row bound to its read-only base now removes the pair's row, and the base row is served again.
- **Addendum item 1, the package-less close on a null binding.** The restore limb's binding is the committing package's row's own (`commitPackageId` when stored, `null` when it is gone). On `null` it asks `packagelessOverlayWriteRefusal` with the rollback arm, exactly as `rollbackMetaItem` does: one predicate, one sentence, no second spelling. The #29390 named-base close is still asked after it.
- **`SysMetadataRepository.restoreVersion` takes `packageId`** (a local extension, as on `delete`): stated, the active row is resolved under `(org, type, name, package_id)`; no such row, the unbound row, as before. Omitted, unchanged.
- **Fixtures.** Seven suites seeded a package's commit over package-less rows, or served a commit row with no `package_id`, a shape no publish produces. Each now binds its rows to the commit's package (no assertion changed). The publish audit harness arms its rival write on the second package-scoped read of the name, since the plan scan now names the package.
- Addendum item 2 (the `packages/spec` migration entry text) is out of this PR, as ordered; the seat routes it.

## Tests

- Red first through the real door (`packages/qa/dogfood/test/package-commit-revert-path-package.dogfood.test.ts`, booted showcase, `origin/main` 7dae3b3c): the pair-beside-base case failed on the plan (`items: [{ existedBefore: true, prevVersion: 10 }]`), and the deleted-row case failed (`success: true`, the package-less row written). Measured on the same head with a probe: the pair commit's revert answered `200 { success: false, failed: [NOT_OVERRIDABLE, the base-row rollback sentence] }` and the pair override stayed served.
- With the fix: that file 12/12 (2 red-first cases, 1 new writable-package control: an edit commit restores its own row in place; the #29090 and #29390 cases unchanged).
- Unit (`src/protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts`): 3 new cases (pair create commit removes the pair row, pair edit commit restores the pair's row only, deleted-row revert refused with the same message as the per-item rollback). All 3 red with `protocol.ts` and `sys-metadata-repository.ts` restored from 7dae3b3c (3 failed / 22 passed), green with the fix (25/25).
- Ablation: dropping only the restore limb's package-less close reds exactly the deleted-row case (1 failed / 24 passed); restored from `HEAD`, the tree diff empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **`rollbackMetaItem` shares the addressing defect (measured, not fixed here).** `POST /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.default/rollback` beside a base-bound row and the pair's override answered `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` naming the base row: its binding read (`resolveOverlayPackageBinding`) and `restoreVersion`'s active-row read are package-agnostic, and the door takes no package, so the pair's row cannot be rolled back through it while a base row of the name is stored. Reported to the seat as a finding.
- Commits recorded before this change keep the plan they recorded (a pair commit beside a base row says `existedBefore: true` with the base row's version). Their revert now restores that version into the pair's own row; `sys_metadata_history` carries no `package_id`, so such a plan cannot be told apart.
